name: Boulder'gor
summary: Boulder'gor is a rugged hill in the western Arathi Highlands, situated directly north of the ruined human kingdom of Stromgarde. It serves as an active encampment for the Boulderfist ogres and their unusual allies among the Witherbark forest trolls.

sections.title: A Den of Ogres and Trolls
sections.body: Rising just north of the crumbling ramparts of Stromgarde Keep, Boulder'gor is a steep bluff claimed by the Boulderfist clan. Within its shadows sits the Boulderfist Outpost mound, making it a central bastion of ogre power across the highlands. Uniquely, the ogres here share their fires and fortifications with forest trolls of the Witherbark tribe, including shadowy spellcasters who lend their dark magic to the clan's brute force. This mutual cooperation poses an ongoing danger to any travelers passing along the central roads of Arathi.

sections.title: Surrounding Territory
sections.body: The slopes around Boulder'gor look down over the open highlands of western Arathi. Hemmed between the Syndicate-infiltrated ruins of Stromgarde and the wild elemental sites of the plains, Boulder'gor remains a heavily guarded and hostile stronghold of tribal solidarity against both Alliance and Horde wanderers.

faq.answer: Boulder'gor is an elevated hill and encampment north of Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands. It is heavily inhabited by Boulderfist ogres and Witherbark forest trolls.

faq.q: Why are forest trolls living alongside ogres here?
faq.answer: The Witherbark trolls and Boulderfist ogres maintain a pragmatic alliance in Arathi. Both seek to maintain dominance over the highlands and fend off rival factions, pooling troll shadowcraft with brute ogre strength.

faq.q: What major landmarks are near Boulder'gor?
faq.answer: Boulder'gor sits directly north of Stromgarde Keep, and the ogre mound of Boulderfist Outpost lies within the hill itself.

faq.q: Is Boulder'gor friendly to the Horde or Alliance?
faq.answer: Neither. The Boulderfist ogres and Witherbark trolls of Boulder'gor are entirely hostile to both the Alliance and the Horde, aggressively defending their hill from outsiders.

angles.text: Darkspear trolls visiting the highlands will find no kinship here: the Witherbark forest trolls of Boulder'gor harbor deep ancient grudges against all outsiders, including other troll tribes.
For Alliance forces seeking to reclaim Stromgarde, Boulder'gor represents a serious threat lurking right on the fallen kingdom's northern doorstep.
